message: Operation 'listCustomers' has semantic quality issues: missing_output_details, poor_ai_interpretability. data.current_description: Returns customers and their subscription info. These are the records the MoonClerk web interface calls "Plans". Filters may be combined; all date filters are `YYYY-MM-DD` and UTC-based, with `*_from` starting at the beginning of the day and `*_to` running through the end of it.
data.description_suggestion: Returns customers and their subscription information, ordered newest first. These records are called "Plans" in the MoonClerk web interface but follow Stripe's customer and subscription constructs in the API. Supports filtering by multiple criteria including date ranges (`YYYY-MM-DD` UTC format, where `*_from` starts at day beginning and `*_to` runs through day end), customer status, and subscription state. Supports `count` and `offset` paging (default 10 rows).
